card.name: Statistics just before a year is given
card.fires_on: Words and digits right before a year is stated, in sentences that report statistics such as population, deaths or amounts. Seen on the digits of a year, on 'of' in 'at the end of', and on the space before a year.

modes.label: Inside a year
modes.description: Digits of a year like 2009 or 2011 that follows a reported figure.
modes.example: some 29 million pounds in 2<<0>>09, or about 60

modes.label: Just before the year
modes.description: A linking word or space leading into a year after a statistic.
modes.example: people were living with HIV at the end<< of>> 2011. An estimated

modes.label: Inside a population count
modes.description: Last digits of a census population figure before the census year.
modes.example: its population was 10,47<<1>> in the 2010 census

card.writes: It pushes toward words that introduce yearly reports and data, such as 'statistics', 'annual', 'last year' and 'data show'.
card.plain: It marks spots in a sentence where a statistic is being tied to a particular year.
